sources.label: Celo BRLA proxy and verified BRLAV1_1 implementation

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-10-19 at Celo block 80489818 (2026-10-19T06:16:16Z), the material deployment holding 90.06% of 41,217,012.27 BRLA (Polygon 8.8014%, Gnosis 1.1386%, Moonbeam 0%). The Celo proxy 0xfecb3f7c54e2caae9dc6ac9060a822d47e053760 resolves to verified BRLAV1_1 implementation 0xe6a537a407488807f0bbeb0038b79004f19dddfb. complianceWallet() returned 0x08AbF5F6E956b7DE8B2880d0E5897F67F181De76 and hasRole(COMPLIANCE_ROLE, that address) returned true; paused() returned false. The verified implementation grants BLACKLISTED via blockAddress(address) onlyRole(COMPLIANCE_ROLE), and _beforeTokenTransfer requires !hasRole(BLACKLISTED, from) and !hasRole(BLACKLISTED, to) under whenNotPaused. That is an active holder-targeted blacklist on the material deployment. The Polygon 8.8014% deployment carries the same control and is disclosed but sub-threshold. Reserves are 54.52% BRL cash and 45.48% overnight repo, entirely custodial bank/fiat exposure, which would satisfy the upstream test, but a direct Yes outranks it.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: The historical 2026-07-20 review classified BRLA as an issuer-native multichain token with mint() gated by Avenia's OPERATOR_ROLE (0x97667070c54ef182b0f5858b034beac1b6f3089aa2d3188bb1e8929f4fa9b929), and reported only issuer-affiliated role holders and no third-party bridge minters. The 2026-10-01 pinned RPC checks reconfirmed all 26 previously authored operator memberships and their functional mint permissions. Completeness of the current holder set, exclusive issuer affiliation, and ownership of backend proxies were not re-established; the failed wide-range role-event queries do not prove that no additional or third-party holders exist.
